pop3_enabled.description: Enable the standard POP3 service on port 110.

pop3_port.description: TCP port number for POP3 service. Typically 110 (or 0 to disable).

pop3_tls_enabled.description: Enable POP3 over SSL/TLS (POP3S) on the configured port.

pop3s_port.description: TCP port number for POP3S service. Typically 995.

debug_mode.description: Enable debug mode (logs verbose output). Should be disabled in production.

debug_port.description: Port used for debug-mode POP3 listener (usually localhost only).

prefork_workers.description: Number of preforked worker processes per service. 0 = let master manage dynamically.
